completeProfile.consent_p_1: Thank you for choosing VitalFlow for your mobility assessment and treatment. The VitalFlow program involves a comprehensive evaluation and treatment process. As with any form of medical intervention, individual responses to treatment may vary, and it is not always possible to predict the outcome due to the unique nature of each person's condition. If you have any questions or concerns about your evaluation or recommended treatment plan, please inform your assigned Physical Therapist (PT) immediately. They will explain the treatment rationale and make any necessary modifications to your program.
completeProfile.consent_p_2: All VitalFlow Specialists are qualified Physiotherapists who specialize in diagnosing and treating musculoskeletal (MSK) injuries and disorders and all VitalFlow treatment plans may include personalized exercise plans which includes muscle activation exercises, strengthening exercises, stretches and Mobility Exercises.

mobility.didYouKnowDescription: Improving your joint mobility not only relieves pain but also boosts posture, balance and energy levels.
mobility.list1: Your right shoulder is almost at optimal mobility
mobility.list2: Your left shoulder extension is close to optimal
mobility.mobilityOverviewDescription: This chart provides a snapshot of your current mobility compared to your full potential. Each section represents a joint and its related movement. The more filled the circle, the closer you are to optimal mobility.
mobility.description1: You're in top form! You move with ease, flexibility, and full range—perfect for peak performance. There's no limitation to your movement.
mobility.description2: You're strong and agile with a bit of room for improvement. Your daily movements are efficient, though you may have some minor restrictions that don't slow you down.
mobility.description: You're doing well, but some stiffness or limitations might affect certain activities. A bit of focused mobility work can help you move even better.
mobility.description4: Your movements are a bit restricted, causing occasional discomfort or inefficiencies. With the right corrective exercises, you'll regain more fluid movement.
mobility.description5: You face significant mobility challenges, affecting daily activities. There is an increased risk of stiffness, pain, or injury, requiring focused rehabilitation to restore function.
mobility.description6: You're dealing with severe mobility restrictions, which may be affecting your independence. Immediate intervention and focused support are needed to improve your mobility.
